claims: Charles Barkley has lost over 80 pounds.
Charles Barkley dropped from a post-retirement high of over 350 pounds.
Charles Barkley dropped to roughly 265–270 pounds as of early 2026.
Charles Barkley credited his weight loss to using GLP-1 medications like Mounjaro and Zepbound to manage appetite, combined with improved diet and exercise.
Charles Barkley began using Mounjaro in 2023.
Charles Barkley later switched to Zepbound.
Charles Barkley has been vocal that the medication helps with portion control.
Charles Barkley dropped from approximately 352 pounds to roughly 267 pounds.
Charles Barkley was motivated to lose weight for health reasons addressing high blood pressure and stroke risks.
Charles Barkley reached 355 pounds following hip replacement surgery.
Charles Barkley aimed to reach 250–270 pounds.
Charles Barkley expressed a desire to eventually stop the medication to see if he can maintain the weight through lifestyle changes.
Charles Barkley's weight loss was a frequent topic of discussion on Inside the NBA during the 2024–2025 season.
